title: KCP context_assembly_create request (DESIGN.md §10.8, §14.1, §11.6.1 prepare/propose + worker families)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Requests an immutable ContextAssembly (§10.8): the §11.6.1 context-assembly-request row's inputs mapped onto §10.8 field names (gap note KG26). K1 direct invocation uses the built-in explicit_refs_v1 selection policy and needs no saved recipe (§10.8 spelled); required refs are never silently replaced — assembly fails rather than silently truncating (§10.8). The wire form of ctx.assemble_context (§14.1); the SDK operation_key travels as meta.idempotency_key (gap note KG15 pattern). Dual-surface operation: one schema pair serves both registry entries (byom G35 pattern; gap note KG14). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal (assurance: current login) | surface worker / fenced worker (exact listed proposal operation in its capability) (assurance: worker capability). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

audience_ref.description: The intended assembly audience (§10.8 record field); materialization reauthorizes the requester/target/source/destination intersection on every use (§10.8).

selection_policy_ref.description: Every assembly binds one selection-policy identifier and digest (§10.8 spelled); K1 uses the built-in explicit_refs_v1 policy.

required_refs.description: Exact explicit selection input (§14.1 required_refs; §10.8: stale, erased, reclassified, or unauthorized inputs cause explicit omission or failure). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

trigger_refs.description: §10.8 trigger_refs[]; at most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

recipe_ref.description: Optional exact ContextRecipe binding (§10.8); reusable/dynamic assemblies are K2 (gap note KG26).

attempt_id.description: Worker-surface binding: every worker operation carries {attempt_id, fence_epoch} (§15.2). Required together with fence_epoch on the worker surface, forbidden on external_client — a (operation, surface) registry rule the shared schema cannot express (gap note KG14).

args.description: Caller-suppliable §10.8 ContextAssembly fields (gap note KG26); frontier_ref/digest, items, relations, transformations, omissions, classification join, totals, versions, authority members, and the assembly digest are server-derived selection evidence (gap note KG5).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

freeText.description: Bounded free text. §11.8 bounds free text again at admission; the 4096-scalar schema ceiling is the recorded extraction bound (ops README gap note KG8).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
